findings.title: Stand-down's owed-Hide PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED registration is a bare self:RegisterEvent, outside the pcalled NS.SafeRegisterEvent helper
findings.locations: core/WhatGroup.lua:436; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:184-186 (hub claim 'never a bare self:RegisterEvent')
findings.evidence: WG-67 remediation routed four feature registrations through NS.SafeRegisterEvent (:374-382), but NS.StandDown's transient self:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED","OnDisabledCombatEnded") is bare. findings.remediation: Use NS.SafeRegisterEvent(self, "PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED", "OnDisabledCombatEnded", NS.RejectedEvents); pin with the kit mock's __badEvents in tests/test_disabled.lua so a rejected name leaves NS.StandDown completing (audit 04 §1).

findings.title: Teleport-cooldown reader compares cooldown values that can be secret in combat, killing the popup ticker and aborting the join notice
findings.locations: core/Compat.lua:109-112; modules/Frame.lua:587-589 (ticker); core/WhatGroup.lua:828 (chat Teleport row), :1026/:1041 (ShowNotification before ShowFrame)
findings.evidence: Compat.GetSpellCooldownRemaining does 'if start <= 0 or duration <= GCD_SECONDS' and arithmetic with no IsSecret guard; LibKa0s Compat.lua:232-233 documents startTime/duration/modRate as possibly secret in combat. Harness probe with comparison-raising values: './core/Compat.lua:112: attempt to compare table with number' from both the ticker and ShowNotification. AceTimer reschedules only after callback returns, so the ticker dies; the details link row, auto-show popup and combat defer never happen. modules/Diagnostics.lua:21 already acknowledges the hazard. Not verified in client (smoke S-001).
findings.remediation: Add Compat.IsSecret guard arm (library's IsSecret, else three-line issecretvalue stub per anti-patterns #47); GetSpellCooldownRemaining returns 0,false when either value is secret; ticker skips unreadable ticks keeping its text and staying armed; Teleport row omits the tag when unreadable. Update compat-layer.md and module-map.md (review C-001).

findings.title: Test mock cannot produce a secret cooldown, so the suite never exercises F-001's combat path
findings.evidence: GetSpellCooldown mock returns plain numbers; no issecretvalue global or secret helper. F-001 shipped through 914 green cases and a regression re-introducing the unguarded compare would also pass.
findings.remediation: Add mock.secret(v) (raising __lt/__le/__add/__sub/__concat) and mock.issecretvalue exposed as a bare global, commented to retire at upstream U-2; add three cases (test_compat, test_frame ticker, test_notify) with red-under comments; regenerate docs/test-cases.md and README badge in the same commit (review C-002).

findings.title: /wg test notify and the panel Test button overwrite the player's real captured group in pendingInfo
findings.evidence: RunTest sets self.pendingInfo = self:SampleInfo() with no restore, unlike test mode which keeps its own record. Afterwards the details link, /wg show and launcher Show window open 'Test Group — Windrunner Spire +12'. Conflicts with preview-mode 'MUST clear the preview and return to live data'.
findings.remediation: RunTest stops writing pendingInfo: ShowNotification takes the sample as an argument and a new NS.FramePreviewOnce() renders through previewInfo/shownInfo() as a one-shot preview cleared on dismiss; update test_lifecycle/test_testmode assertions and docs slash-dispatch.md:89, scope.md:14, frame.md:63, module-map.md (review C-003).

findings.title: Panel Test button pressed while disabled builds a hidden popup that appears unasked when the addon is re-enabled; its test only checks stored data
